# Dominik Gehl Photography

> > Architectural photography documenting Swiss buildings, museums, and cultural landmarks across Switzerland, featuring works by Christ & Gantenbein, Jean Tschumi, and other notable architects.

Dominik Gehl specializes in photographing Swiss architecture, from historic castles and Art Nouveau churches to contemporary museums and brutalist structures. The portfolio spans major Swiss cities including Zürich, Lausanne, Basel, and Geneva, capturing both iconic cultural institutions and innovative residential projects.

## Key Topics

- Swiss Architecture
- Architectural Photography
- Christ & Gantenbein
- Kunstmuseum Basel
- Lausanne Architecture
- Zürich Architecture

## Museums & Cultural Institutions

- [Kunstmuseum Basel](https://dominikgehl.com/basel-kunstmuseum): Kunstmuseum Basel photography by Rudolf Christ & Paul Bonatz design
- [Lindt Home of Chocolate](https://dominikgehl.com/zurich-lindt-home-of-chocolate): Lindt museum in Kilchberg by Christ & Gantenbein (2020)
- [EPFL Pavilions](https://dominikgehl.com/epfl-pavilions): Exhibition space by Kengo Kuma at EPFL (2016)
- [Bourbaki Panorama](https://dominikgehl.com/luzern-bourbaki-panorama): Lucerne panorama painting by Edouard Castres (1876)

## Concert Halls & Public Spaces

- [Salle de Musique, La Chaux-de-Fonds](https://dominikgehl.com/la-chaux-de-fonds-salle-de-musique): Concert hall in La Chaux-de-Fonds by Chapallaz & Bieri (1951)
- [Aula des Cèdres](https://dominikgehl.com/lausanne-aula-des-cedres): Lausanne brutalist hall by Jean Tschumi with hyperbolic roof (1962)

## Zürich Architecture

- [Escherhof (Richti-Areal)](https://dominikgehl.com/zurich-escherhof-richti-areal): Zurich residential building by SAM Architekten (2010-2013)
- [Station 595](https://dominikgehl.com/zurich-station-595): Zurich mixed-use loft conversion by Guagliardi Ruoss (2014-2016)

## Lausanne & Geneva Region

- [Tour Bel-Air](https://dominikgehl.com/lausanne-tour-bel-air): Lausanne skyscraper by Alphonse Laverrière (1932)
- [Villa Mon Repos](https://dominikgehl.com/lausanne-villa-mon-repos): Lausanne neoclassical villa, IOC headquarters built 1747
- [P+R Étoile](https://dominikgehl.com/geneve-pr-etoile): Geneva parking architecture by Strausak Associés SA (2000)
- [Trait d'union](https://dominikgehl.com/prilly-trait-dunion): Prilly-Renens underpass by Pont12 Architectes (2020)

## Historic Buildings & Heritage Sites

- [Château de Valangin](https://dominikgehl.com/valangin-chateau): 12th century castle in Canton Neuchâtel, Swiss heritage site
- [Pfarrkirche St. Peter und Paul](https://dominikgehl.com/villmergen-pfarrkirche-st-peter-und-paul): Villmergen church by Wilhelm Keller with Art Nouveau details (1866)

## Regional Portfolios

- [Architectural Landmarks in La Chaux-de-Fonds](https://dominikgehl.com/la-chaux-de-fonds): La Chaux-de-Fonds architectural photography portfolio collection
